The '''''Triumph''''' was a [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] [[Theta-class T-1 vessel|''Theta''-class T-1 vessel]] owned by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. Bane flew in the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] on a [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|mission]] to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] in [[980 BBY]] to acquire the [[Holocron of Heresies|holocron]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Andeddu]]. Bane subsequently took by force the knowledge of how to [[Essence transfer|transfer one's essence]] into another body from the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] during his journey in the ''Triumph'' back to [[Darth Bane's mansion|his home]] on [[Ciutric IV]].

==Description==
The [[Theta-class T-1 vessel|''Theta''-class T-1 vessel]] ''Triumph'' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] produced by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]]. It was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and required no more than one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], although it could also carry at least one additional passenger.<ref name="Doe" />

==History==
[[File:DarthBane-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|125px|Darth Bane, owner of the ''Triumph'']]
The ''Triumph'' was the personal shuttle of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. For several years, he lived in a [[Darth Bane's mansion|mansion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ciutric IV]] with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. While on Ciutric IV, he kept the ''Triumph'' in a nearby [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="Doe" />

In [[980 BBY]], Bane discovered that the legendary [[Holocron of Heresies|holocron]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Andeddu]]&mdash;which was rumored to contain the secret to eternal life&mdash;was located on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. Bane then embarked on a [[Mission to Prakith (Darth Bane)|mission]] to Prakith in the ''Triumph'', making carefully calculated [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps in the shuttle along the dangerous Deep Core [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] before arriving safely at his destination.<ref name="Doe" />

Bane successfully acquired the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from [[Andeddu's Keep|Andeddu's tomb]] and quickly fled Prakith in the ''Triumph''. He studied the holocron on his return trip, forcefully taking the knowledge of the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] to [[Essence transfer|transfer one's essence]] from the [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] during the journey back to Ciutric IV in his shuttle. This mission proved to be Bane's final flight in the ''Triumph'', as he was soon after [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|captured]] and taken to [[Doan]], before eventually being [[Duel on Doan|challenged]] [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|twice]] by his apprentice, the second time resulting in his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Doe" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Theta''-class T-1 vessel ''Triumph'' was owned and operated by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Bane, the creator of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]].<ref name="Doe" />

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle ''Triumph'' received its first appearance in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the final novel of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']], released [[December 8]], [[2009]].
